main_text.l: respectu Soceri, aut Socrus. Plur. לְמִבְרְזָא חֲתְנִין : כַּלָּן Ad copulandum sponsos & sponsas, Deut.34.6. in T.Jon. Cum Aff. וְכַלְּתְהָא Et nurus ejus, Ruth.1.6.
כְּלִיתָא Ch. Thalamus, Exod.2.1. in Jon.
כְּלַם Ch. Veterascere, inveterascere, Deut.29.4. in Jon. Aphel אַכְלִים Ignominiâ afficere, Confundere. Ithpeh. אִתְכְּלַם Erubescere, rubore, pudore suffundi, ignominiâ affici.
כְּלוֹם Ch. Aliquid, quicquam, לֵית כְּלוֹם פַּתְגָם Nihil quicquam est, Eccles.1.9.
ܟܠܡܘܣ Syr. Chlamys, χλαμυς Græc. ܟܠܡܘܣ
כְּלִנְסָא, כְּלִנְסָא, כְּלִנְסָן Ch. Vectis. Plur. כְּלוּנְסָן, Num.35.20.in Jon. In Venetis prave scribitur per ב.
כְּלַף Ch. Ex adverso, E regione, Versus, Cotra.
כְּלֵשׁ Syr. Dealbare. Aphel Participium, ܣܦܝܠܟܪܐ Sepulchra dealbata, Matt.23.27.
כְּמָא Ch. כְּמָת, כְּמָתֵן Syr. Sicut, Quemadmodu, quomodo: כְּמָתִי Sicut ego, כְּמָתָהּ Sicut ille. Vide praeterea in מָה, מָא.
כְּמַן Ch. Abscondere, recondere: Latere, insidiari, insidias struere. Pahel כְּמַן Idem. Ex Ithpeh. Infinit. בְּאִתְכְּמוֹנִיהוֹן Dum insidias excogitant, Hos.7.6.
כְּמְנָא Syr. Insidiae: Act.23.21. & 25.3. Item Insidiator Chald. Jud.16.9. Plur. constr. בְּכְמָנֵי In insidiis. Psalm.10.8.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several vocalised forms and the Syriac lines are partly uncertain. The last line (כמונא) is a catchword-like word set alone at the foot, given here as printed.
